title: ParchMark monorepo restructure
summary: Moves the current ParchMark web code into parchmark-web/ and folds the parchmark-mcp repository in at parchmark-mcp/, leaving a meta repository root that drives both.
motivation: One repository for the web app and its MCP server, ahead of artifact work that spans both.

included: git move of backend, ui, deploy, docs, makefiles, testdata, Dockerfile, docker-compose*.yml, authelia-dev-config.yml, the .env examples and the Makefile into parchmark-web/
a meta root holding .forgejo, .karta, .claude, .gitignore, .mcp.json, README.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and a delegating Makefile
a copy of parchmark-mcp at parchmark-mcp/ with its nested .git removed
path updates in CI workflows, Makefiles, compose files, deploy scripts, .claude/settings.json and docs
excluded: carrying over the parchmark-mcp git history (a plain copy is deliberate)
any artifact, token or feature change
renaming or refactoring the moved code

design_facts.stack: Python/FastAPI backend + Vue 3 UI + Python FastMCP MCP server, PostgreSQL

work_items.title: Relocate the web app into parchmark-web
work_items.summary: Moves every current top-level project into parchmark-web/ and rebuilds the repo root as a meta repository.
work_items.contract: parchmark-web/ holds backend, ui, deploy, docs, makefiles, testdata, Dockerfile, the docker-compose files, authelia-dev-config.yml, the .env examples and the Makefile. The repo root keeps .forgejo, .karta, .claude, .gitignore, .mcp.json, README.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and a delegating Makefile whose targets run make -C parchmark-web. No backend/ or ui/ directory remains at the repo root.

signals: blast radius: moves every path in the repository and edits CI, Makefiles, compose files, deploy scripts and agent config

assertions: make test passes from the repository root through the delegating Makefile
no backend/ or ui/ directory remains at the repository root

work_items.title: Fold parchmark-mcp into the repository root
work_items.summary: Copies the MCP server into parchmark-mcp/, drops its nested git directory, and wires it into the root tooling and CI.
work_items.contract: parchmark-mcp/ holds the copied package (pyproject.toml, uv.lock, src, tests, docs, README.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md) with no nested .git. A root .pre-commit-config.yaml runs both projects' hooks. A CI job runs the MCP checks with uv.

signals: capability escalation: adds a second toolchain root and a new CI job
blast radius: edits root CI and the meta docs

oracle.command: uv run ruff check src/ tests/ && uv run ruff format --check src/ tests/ && uv run pyright src/ tests/ && uv run pytest tests/ -q
assertions: ruff check, ruff format --check, pyright and pytest all pass
